en: AI Insurance: Frameworks, Application Cases, and Market Trends
zh: AI保险：责任框架、应用案例与市场趋势

excerpts.zh: 当 AI 获得决策权，责任如何划分也成为产品问题。
excerpts.en: As AI gains decision-making power, allocating responsibility becomes a product question.

excerpts.zh: 自动决策的失误可能来自硬件、软件、网络或人机交接。
excerpts.en: Failures in automated decisions can involve hardware, software, networks or human handovers.

excerpts.zh: 分析责任时，需要区分系统自主运行和人应当接管的时刻。
excerpts.en: Responsibility analysis needs to distinguish autonomous operation from expected human intervention.

excerpts.zh: AI 的幻觉、偏见与未经授权的操作，会带来不同类型的损失。
excerpts.en: Hallucinations, bias and unauthorized actions create different kinds of loss.

excerpts.zh: 当运行日志由厂商独自掌控，定责证据也会面临信任问题。
excerpts.en: When vendors alone control operational logs, evidence about responsibility raises trust questions.

excerpts.zh: 模型的随机性让风险评估与保险定价更难稳定下来。
excerpts.en: Model variability makes risk assessment and insurance pricing harder to stabilize.
